title: pseudogynoxys volubilis
intro: Pseudogynoxys volubilis, commonly known as the 'False Goldenseal', is a plant species native to the Andean region of South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pseudogynoxys volubilis are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antiparasitic and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
